+    _TTY_MACRO = re.compile(
+        r'(?<!\w)(?:(?P<italic>I\((?P<italic_text>[^()]+)\))'
+        r'|(?P<bold>B\((?P<bold_text>[^()]+)\))'
+        r'|(?P<module>M\((?P<module_text>[^()]+)\))'
+        r'|(?P<url>U\((?P<url_text>[^()]+)\))'
+        r'|(?P<const>C\((?P<const_text>[^()]+)\))'
+        r'|(?P<link>L\((?P<link_text>[^(),]+),\s*(?P<link_url>[^()]+)\))'
+        r'|(?P<reference>R\((?P<reference_text>[^(),]+),\s*[^()]+\))'
+        r'|(?P<hr>HORIZONTALLINE(?!\w)))'
+    )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        """Render documentation macros for terminal output."""
+        def replace(match):
+            if match.group('italic'):
+                return "`%s'" % match.group('italic_text')
+            if match.group('bold'):
+                return "*%s*" % match.group('bold_text')
+            if match.group('module'):
+                return "[%s]" % match.group('module_text')
+            if match.group('url'):
+                return match.group('url_text')
+            if match.group('const'):
+                return "`%s'" % match.group('const_text')
+            if match.group('link'):
+                return "%s <%s>" % (match.group('link_text').strip(), match.group('link_url').strip())
+            if match.group('reference'):
+                return match.group('reference_text').strip()
+            return '\n-------------\n'
+
+        return cls._TTY_MACRO.sub(replace, text)
+
     def __init__(self, args):
 
         super(DocCLI, self).__init__(args)

+# (c) 2026, Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+class TestDocCLI(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_tty_ify_macros(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(label,https://example.com)'), 'label <https://example.com>')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(label, https://example.com)'), 'label <https://example.com>')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('R(label,reference)'), 'label')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('R(label, reference)'), 'label')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('HORIZONTALLINE'), '\n-------------\n')
+
+    def test_tty_ify_multiple_macros_and_plain_text(self):
+        text = 'Words M(name) and B(text), C(value), R(label,ref), L(link,url)'
+        expected = "Words [name] and *text*, `value', label, link <url>"
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(text), expected)
+
+    def test_tty_ify_existing_macros_and_parenthesized_words(self):
+        text = 'I(emphasis) B(strong) M(module) U(url) C(constant); IBM(International Business Machines) X(foo)'
+        expected = "`emphasis' *strong* [module] url `constant'; IBM(International Business Machines) X(foo)"
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(text), expected)
